reviewer_notes: Only two energy performance models were actually fitted: the compressor EnPI regression models (EnPI1 kWh/Nm3 = M1 and EnPI2 Wh/Nm3/ton = M2), reported in Fig. 4, Fig. 5 and Table I. The extensive DATA SET listings for EAF, VAR/ESR, AOD and air compression are proposed parameter/monitoring frameworks, not fitted models, so they were not coded as models. Model family is ambiguous: the framework section lists MLR, Random Forest, GBM and Neural Networks as candidates, but the reported case-study results are only attributed to the MATLAB 'regression learner', so 'other machine learning' with the tool named was used. Metric placement is ambiguous: the workflow (Fig. 3) describes a train/test split and cross-validation, but the text labels the reported numbers 'training result', so metrics were placed in in_sample_fit and out_of_sample status set to not reported with the described held-out design recorded. Data are pooled/averaged across the three mills (2 Italy, 1 US), treated here as one multi-site application.
